nodes.label: Subprocess Isolation for FRNN Timing
nodes.rationale: PyTorch's caching allocator pre-warms the CUDA context, cuBLAS/cuDNN init steals 100-300 ms, and torch.cuda.synchronize() syncs all streams including FRNN's. Timing FRNN in the same process as PyTorch produces contaminated numbers. IPC overhead is per-invocation, not per-trial.
